title: Domain, Range and Composite Functions
welcome_lead: Map inputs to outputs: discover domain, range and how to compose functions.
meta_desc: IBDP Maths adventure on domain, range, composite and inverse functions.
final_note: Inverses swap inputs and outputs - reflect across y = x!

concepts.def: Set of all valid input x-values of a function.
Set of all possible output y-values of a function.
(f∘g)(x) = f(g(x)), apply g first then f.
Each y has exactly one x; invertible function.
f: x → f(x) assigns one output per input.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Find the domain of f(x) = √(x-3).

Need x - 3 ≥ 0, so domain is x ≥ 3, i.e. [3, ∞).

Find the inverse of f(x) = 3x - 5.

Let y = 3x - 5, swap: x = 3y - 5, solve y = (x+5)/3. So f^(-1)(x) = (x+5)/3.
